021import java.io.*;
022import java.nio.charset.*;

024import org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.*;

036/**
037 * Git repository control operations for cloning, pulling, pushing, and committing.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Provides a simplified wrapper around JGit for server configuration repository management.
041 * Used to fetch configuration files from a remote Git repository.
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * Credentials are never hardcoded in this class.  They are either supplied directly by the caller (via the 5-arg
045 * constructor) or, preferably, resolved at construction time from a pluggable {@link SecretStore} (via the
046 * {@link #GitControl(String, String, String, String, BeanStore, boolean) BeanStore/SecretStore} constructor) so the
047 * password/token can be sourced from an environment variable, an OS keychain, or another secret backend rather than a
048 * literal string.
049 *
050 * <p>
051 * The underlying JGit {@link Repository} and {@link Git} handles are opened in the constructor and released by
052 * {@link #close()}, so instances must be used with try-with-resources to avoid leaking file/native handles.
053 *
054 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
055 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SecretStore}
056 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SecretStores}
057 * </ul>
058 */
059@SuppressWarnings({
060   "resource" // The JGit Repository and Git handles are opened in the constructors and released by close(); callers use GitControl via try-with-resources
061})
062public class GitControl implements AutoCloseable {
063
064   private final String localPath;
065   private final String remotePath;
066   private final Repository localRepo;
067   private final Git git;
068   private final CredentialsProvider cp;
069   private final boolean forcePush;
070
071   /**
072    * Constructor.
073    *
074    * <p>
075    * Equivalent to {@link #GitControl(String, String, String, String, boolean) GitControl(localPath, remotePath,
076    * null, null, false)}: no credentials (anonymous transport) and non-force push.
077    *
078    * @param localPath Local directory path for the repository.
079    * @param remotePath Remote Git repository URI.
080    * @throws IOException If the repository cannot be opened.
081    */
082   public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath) throws IOException {
083      this(localPath, remotePath, null, null, false);
084   }
085
086   /**
087    * Constructor.
088    *
089    * <p>
090    * Credentials are supplied by the caller (typically from operator configuration or a secret store) rather than
091    * hardcoded.  Pass {@code null} for {@code username} to use anonymous transport.
092    *
093    * @param localPath Local directory path for the repository.
094    * @param remotePath Remote Git repository URI.
095    * @param username Git username, or <jk>null</jk> for anonymous transport.
096    * @param password Git password/token.  Ignored when {@code username} is <jk>null</jk>.
097    * @param forcePush Whether {@link #pushToRepo()} performs a force-push (destructive remote history rewrite).
098    *    <br>Force-push is opt-in; defaults to <jk>false</jk> in the other constructors.
099    * @throws IOException If the repository cannot be opened.
100    */
101   public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath, String username, String password, boolean forcePush) throws IOException {
102      this.localPath = localPath;
103      this.remotePath = remotePath;
104      this.localRepo = new FileRepository(localPath + "/.git");
105      this.cp = username == null ? null : new UsernamePasswordCredentialsProvider(username, password);
106      this.forcePush = forcePush;
107      git = new Git(localRepo);
108   }
109
110   /**
111    * Constructor that resolves the Git password/token from a pluggable {@link SecretStore}.
112    *
113    * <p>
114    * The active store is resolved from the supplied {@link BeanStore} via {@link SecretStores#resolve(BeanStore)},
115    * defaulting to an {@link InMemorySecretStore} when the bean store is <jk>null</jk> or contributes none.  The
116    * password/token is looked up under <jv>secretKey</jv> as a {@code char[]} so it is never materialized as a
117    * {@link String}, and the credentials are zeroed by {@link #close()}.  Pass <jk>null</jk> for <jv>username</jv> to
118    * use anonymous transport (the secret store is not consulted in that case).
119    *
120    * @param localPath Local directory path for the repository.
121    * @param remotePath Remote Git repository URI.
122    * @param username Git username, or <jk>null</jk> for anonymous transport.
123    * @param secretKey The key under which the password/token is stored in the resolved {@link SecretStore}.
124    *    <br>Ignored when <jv>username</jv> is <jk>null</jk>.
125    * @param beanStore The bean store to resolve the {@link SecretStore} from.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to use the
126    *    default {@link InMemorySecretStore}.
127    * @param forcePush Whether {@link #pushToRepo()} performs a force-push (destructive remote history rewrite).
128    *    <br>Force-push is opt-in; defaults to <jk>false</jk> in the other constructors.
129    * @throws IOException If the repository cannot be opened.
130    */
131   public GitControl(String localPath, String remotePath, String username, String secretKey, BeanStore beanStore, boolean forcePush) throws IOException {
132      this.localPath = localPath;
133      this.remotePath = remotePath;
134      this.localRepo = new FileRepository(localPath + "/.git");
135      this.cp = findCredentialsProvider(username, secretKey, beanStore);
136      this.forcePush = forcePush;
137      git = new Git(localRepo);
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Builds the credentials provider by resolving the password/token from the {@link SecretStore} contributed to the
142    * supplied bean store.
143    *
144    * <p>
145    * Returns <jk>null</jk> (anonymous transport) when <jv>username</jv> is <jk>null</jk>.  When the secret is absent
146    * from the resolved store an empty password is used, so a caller cannot accidentally send a stale literal.  The
147    * retrieved {@code char[]} is handed to the provider and zeroed by {@link #close()}.
148    *
149    * @param username Git username, or <jk>null</jk> for anonymous transport.
150    * @param secretKey The key under which the password/token is stored.
151    * @param beanStore The bean store to resolve the {@link SecretStore} from.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
152    * @return The credentials provider, or <jk>null</jk> for anonymous transport.
153    */
154   static CredentialsProvider findCredentialsProvider(String username, String secretKey, BeanStore beanStore) {
155      if (username == null)
156         return null;
157      var secret = SecretStores.resolve(beanStore).find(secretKey).orElseGet(() -> new char[0]);
158      return new UsernamePasswordCredentialsProvider(username, secret);
159   }
160
161   /**
162    * Closes the underlying JGit {@link Git} and {@link Repository} handles.
163    *
164    * <p>
165    * The {@link Git} instance wraps an externally-supplied {@link Repository} (it does not close it on
166    * {@link Git#close()}), so both are released explicitly here.  Any credentials held by the provider are zeroed so
167    * a resolved secret does not linger in memory beyond the life of this instance.
168    */
169   @Override
170   public void close() {
171      git.close();
172      localRepo.close();
173      if (cp instanceof UsernamePasswordCredentialsProvider cp2)
174         cp2.clear();
175   }
176
177   /**
178    * Stages all files for commit.
179    *
180    * @throws GitAPIException If staging fails.
181    */
182   public void addToRepo() throws GitAPIException {
183      var add = git.add();
184      add.addFilepattern(".").call();
185   }
186
187   /**
188    * Checks out the specified branch from origin.
189    *
190    * @param name Branch name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
191    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the branch name is not valid (leading '-', <c>HEAD</c>, or characters outside <c>[A-Za-z0-9._/-]</c>).
192    * @throws GitAPIException If checkout fails.
193    */
194   public void branch(String name) throws GitAPIException {
195      BranchNames.validate(name);
196      git.checkout().setName(name).setStartPoint("origin/".concat(name)).call();
197   }
198
199   /**
200    * Clones the remote repository to the local path.
201    *
202    * @throws GitAPIException If clone fails.
203    */
204   public void cloneRepo() throws GitAPIException {
205      // call() returns a Git handle wrapping the freshly-cloned repo; the clone (working tree on disk) is the
206      // side-effect we want, so close the returned handle immediately to avoid leaking file/native handles.
207      try (var g = Git.cloneRepository().setURI(remotePath).setDirectory(new File(localPath)).call()) {
208         // No further operations needed on the cloned handle.
209      }
210   }
211
212   /**
213    * Commits staged changes with the specified message.
214    *
215    * @param message Commit message.
216    * @throws JGitInternalException If an internal JGit error occurs.
217    * @throws GitAPIException If commit fails.
218    */
219   public void commitToRepo(String message)
220      throws JGitInternalException, GitAPIException {
221      git.commit().setMessage(message).call();
222   }
223
224   /**
225    * Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository.
226    *
227    * @throws GitAPIException If pull fails.
228    */
229   public void pullFromRepo() throws GitAPIException {
230      git.pull().call();
231   }
232
233   /**
234    * Fetches the latest changes from the remote repository without touching the working tree or the current branch.
235    *
236    * @throws GitAPIException If fetch fails.
237    */
238   public void fetchFromRepo() throws GitAPIException {
239      git.fetch().call();
240   }
241
242   /**
243    * Reads a file's content from the object database at the tip of the specified branch.
244    *
245    * <p>
246    * The remote-tracking ref <c>origin/<jv>branch</jv></c> is preferred, falling back to the local branch.  The
247    * working tree and the checked-out branch are not consulted.  The size limit is applied while the blob stream is
248    * read, so an oversized blob is never loaded whole.
249    *
250    * @param branch Branch name.  Must satisfy the same validation as {@link #branch(String)}.
251    * @param path Path of the file relative to the repository root.
252    * @param maxBytes Maximum number of bytes allowed.
253    * @return The file content (UTF-8), or <jk>null</jk> if the file does not exist at that commit.
254    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the branch name is not valid.
255    * @throws IOException If the branch does not exist, the blob exceeds <jv>maxBytes</jv>, or it cannot be read.
256    */
257   public String readBlob(String branch, String path, long maxBytes) throws IOException {
258      BranchNames.validate(branch);
259      var id = localRepo.resolve("refs/remotes/origin/".concat(branch));
260      if (id == null)
261         id = localRepo.resolve("refs/heads/".concat(branch));
262      if (id == null)
263         throw new IOException("Branch not found.");
264      try (var reader = localRepo.newObjectReader(); var walk = new RevWalk(reader)) {
265         var tree = walk.parseCommit(id).getTree();
266         var entry = TreeWalk.forPath(reader, path, tree);
267         if (entry == null || entry.isSubtree())
268            return null;
269         var loader = reader.open(entry.getObjectId(0));
270         if (loader.getSize() > maxBytes)
271            throw tooLarge(maxBytes);
272         try (var in = loader.openStream()) {
273            return readCapped(in, maxBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8, () -> tooLarge(maxBytes));
274         }
275      }
276   }
277
278   private static IOException tooLarge(long maxBytes) {
279      return new IOException("Configuration file exceeds the maximum allowed size of " + maxBytes + " bytes.");
280   }
281
282   /**
283    * Pushes all committed changes to the remote repository.
284    *
285    * @throws JGitInternalException If an internal JGit error occurs.
286    * @throws GitAPIException If push fails.
287    */
288   public void pushToRepo() throws JGitInternalException, GitAPIException {
289      var pc = git.push();
290      if (cp != null)
291         pc.setCredentialsProvider(cp);
292      // Force-push is opt-in (see constructor); a destructive remote history rewrite is never performed by default.
293      pc.setForce(forcePush).setPushAll();
294      try {
295         var it = pc.call().iterator();
296         if (it.hasNext()) {
297            RichLogger.getLogger(GitControl.class).info("%s", it.next().toString());
298         }
299      } catch (InvalidRemoteException e) {
300         RichLogger.getLogger(GitControl.class).warning(e, "Error pushing to remote repository.");
301      }
302   }
303}
